# Home Workshop and Backup Power Inventory

This inventory lists major power and measurement gear kept in the utility room and garage workbench, along with serial numbers and replacement schedules.

## Uninterruptible Power Supply

The office desk and fiber router run behind an APC Back-UPS Pro unit with asset tag UPS-APC-750. Its sealed lead-acid battery cartridge was installed on 2025-08-12 and should be replaced every thirty-six months or whenever the self-test beep lasts longer than three seconds. Keep the rear surge-only outlets reserved for the laser printer so printing spikes do not trip the inverter overload relay.

## Portable Air Compressor

The belt-driven workshop air compressor is a 24-liter Husky oil-lubricated model stored beside the rolling tool chest. Drain condensation water from the bottom brass petcock valve after every weekend painting or tire-inflation session so internal tank rust never builds up. Change the SAE-30 non-detergent compressor oil once a year every October.

## Torque Wrench and Calibration

The half-inch drive click-type torque wrench covers 20 to 150 foot-pounds and lives in its blow-molded gray case on the second shelf. Always dial the micrometer handle back down to 20 foot-pounds after use so the internal coil spring does not take a permanent set and lose calibration accuracy.
